scientific_integrity: Uses previously published renewal transform and variance identities with attribution; only the strict common-mean counterexample, mean-constrained sharp envelopes, and iff reset-distance law identification are asserted as new.
scientific_limitations: The sharp envelopes assume rate-r Poisson resetting, known D and r, iid initialization and resets, and a fixed positive bounded distance interval; no finite-sample inference or stochastic dominance is established. The literature-priority assessment remains subject to external expert review.
title: Sharp fixed-mean first-passage Laplace and variance envelopes for distributed Brownian resetting
